subject: Kraken
text: Kraken has 800 HP, resists Fire and Earth, is weak to Lightning, attacks 8 times, and is neutral to Cold, Status, Poison, Time, and Death.

evidence.quote: Kraken statistics: 800 HP, weak to Lightning, neutral to Cold, Status, Poison, Time, and Death, resists Fire and Earth; attacks hit 8 times

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken uses a regular attack 75% of the time and Ink 25% of the time to try and blind the party.

evidence.quote: Kraken's game-plan is very simple: 75% of the time he will use a regular attack, 25% of the time he will use Ink to try and blind your party.

subject: One for Each Arm
text: Spells targeting the whole party count as one action for each target affected during the Kraken 8-action challenge.

evidence.quote: It should also be noted early on that due to the logic of the challenge, casting spells that target your whole party will count as one action for each target affected - don't go pressing Inv2 or Hel2 here.

subject: Kraken
text: Lit3 can inflict up to 360 damage per cast against Kraken, though roughly 200 damage is more typical.

evidence.quote: Lit3 can potentially do up to 360 damage per cast, though somewhere in the 200 range is more likely.

subject: Kraken
text: Kraken has 60 Absorb, making high-level offensive magic or Fast-buffed physical attacks key strategies.

evidence.quote: Depending on your party composition, beating Kraken with raw physical damage may not be ideal; if you have some Wizards to work with, high level offensive magic may be more of a core strat, since Kraken's 60 Absorb is making the Knight's good old fashioned Silver Sword look a bit outdated.

subject: Of Mighty Magic
text: White Wizards can finish learning 24 spells in Gaia with Fade and Wall, while Black Wizards can purchase any two 8th level spells there.

evidence.quote: _Have a character learn 24 spells._ ... White Wizards can run back to Gaia and fill in the rest of their slots with Fade and Wall (Xfer doesn't do anything when cast); Black Wizards can do the same with any two of the 8th level spells there (you're most likely not going to do anything with them either way).

subject: Mirage Tower
text: Mirage Tower is located in the desert northwest of Lefein, reached by landing the airship on grass to the south and walking.

evidence.quote: Mirage Tower's located in the vast desert northwest of Lefein and you'll have to land the airship on a small patch of grass to the south then walk the rest of the way in order to get there.

subject: Floor 1
text: The interior of Mirage Tower Floor 1 contains 8 chests holding a Cabin, Aegis Shield, 2750 G, 3400 G, 18010 G, Vorpal sword, Heal Helmet, and 880 G.

evidence.quote: After entering Mirage Tower, there are 8 chests accessible in the interior of floor 1 (Cabin, Aegis Shield, 2750 G, 3400 G, 18010 G, Vorpal sword, Heal Helmet, 880 G).

subject: Floor 1
text: In Mirage Tower Floor 1, stairs leading up to Floor 2 are situated across the wall from the entrance.

evidence.quote: The stairs up to Floor 2 are just across the wall from the entrance.

subject: Floor 2
text: To reach the stairs and treasure room on Mirage Tower Floor 2, go counterclockwise around half the room and weave through the pillar rows.

evidence.quote: You'll have to make it through a bit of a pillar maze upon entering Floor 2; getting to the stairs and the treasure room requires going counterclockwise around half the room, then weaving your way through the rows of pillars to get to the interior of the floor.

subject: Thor's Hammer
text: Thor's Hammer is found in the middle-left chest inside the treasure room in the middle of Mirage Tower Floor 2.

evidence.quote: Found in the treasure room in the middle of Floor 2 of the Mirage Tower; it's the middle-left chest, specifically.

subject: Floor 2 treasure room
text: The remaining chests in Mirage Tower Floor 2 treasure room contain 13000 G, 12350 G, 7900 G, 8135 G, Dragon Armor, 10000 G, Sun Sword, 7690 G, and a House.

evidence.quote: After that specific treasure, crack open the rest in this floor 2 treasure room (13000 G, 12350 G, 7900 G, 8135 G, Dragon Armor, 10000 G, Sun Sword, 7690 G, House).

subject: Floor 3
text: Mirage Tower Floor 3 contains a teleporter leading to the Floating Castle, which requires the Cube to operate.

evidence.quote: Floor 3 doesn't actually have anything on it besides a teleporter that goes up to the Floating Castle and requires the Cube to operate (hopefully you have it; if not, it's in the Waterfall Cave near Onrac).

subject: Floor 1 west room
text: Floating Castle Floor 1 west treasure room contains 4 chests with 9900 G, Heal potion, 4150 G, and 7900 G.

evidence.quote: Teleporting to the first floor of the Floating Castle, there's a treasure room to the west (4 chests, 9900 G, Heal potion, 4150 G, 7900 G), a treasure room to the east (5 chests, 5000 G, ProRing, 6720 G, Heal Helmet, 180 G), and a treasure room to the south (1 chest, Bane Sword).

subject: Floor 1 east room
text: Floating Castle Floor 1 east treasure room contains 5 chests with 5000 G, ProRing, 6720 G, Heal Helmet, and 180 G.

evidence.quote: Teleporting to the first floor of the Floating Castle, there's a treasure room to the west (4 chests, 9900 G, Heal potion, 4150 G, 7900 G), a treasure room to the east (5 chests, 5000 G, ProRing, 6720 G, Heal Helmet, 180 G), and a treasure room to the south (1 chest, Bane Sword).

subject: Floor 1 south room
text: Floating Castle Floor 1 south treasure room contains 1 chest holding the Bane Sword.

evidence.quote: Teleporting to the first floor of the Floating Castle, there's a treasure room to the west (4 chests, 9900 G, Heal potion, 4150 G, 7900 G), a treasure room to the east (5 chests, 5000 G, ProRing, 6720 G, Heal Helmet, 180 G), and a treasure room to the south (1 chest, Bane Sword).

subject: Floor 1
text: The teleporter leading to Floor 2 of the Floating Castle is located to the north.

evidence.quote: The teleporter to Floor 2 is up north.

subject: Floor 2 northwest room
text: The northwest room of Floating Castle Floor 2 contains 2 chests holding a Silver Helmet and a House.

evidence.quote: Floor 2 is laid out like a compass; northwest is a room containing 2 chests (Silver Helmet, House).

subject: Floor 2 west room
text: The west room of Floating Castle Floor 2 contains 2 chests holding 880 G and 13000 G.

evidence.quote: West contains 2 more chests (880 G, 13000 G).

subject: Floor 2 southwest room
text: The southwest room of Floating Castle Floor 2 contains 1 chest holding the Adamant.

evidence.quote: Southwest contains 1 chest (Adamant).

subject: Floor 2 southeast room
text: The southeast room of Floating Castle Floor 2 contains 2 chests holding a Black Shirt and a White Shirt.

evidence.quote: Southeast has 2 chests (Black Shirt, White Shirt).

subject: Floor 2 east room
text: The east room of Floating Castle Floor 2 contains 2 chests holding an Opal Shield and a Ribbon.

evidence.quote: East has 2 chests (Opal Shield, Ribbon).

subject: Floor 2 northeast room
text: The northeast room of Floating Castle Floor 2 contains 1 chest holding an Opal Gauntlet.

evidence.quote: Northeast contains 1 chest (Opal Gauntlet).

subject: Floor 2
text: Directly south from the starting teleporter on Floating Castle Floor 2 is the teleporter to Floor 3.

evidence.quote: Directly south from the starting teleporter is the teleporter to Floor 3, which has a couple standalone tasks to deal with right away.

subject: God's Eye View
text: Upon teleporting to Floor 3, speak to the nearby green robot and examine the hole at the bottom of the rectangular window.

evidence.quote: As soon as you teleport up to Floor 3, you can talk to the green robot nearby and then examine the hole in the bottom of the rectangular "window" to get this bit of text.

subject: Floor 3 left-hand room
text: A Katana is located in the furthest right chest of the 4 chests in the left-hand path treasure room on Floating Castle Floor 3.

evidence.quote: Found in the treasure room along the left-hand path from where you got the previous achievement; there's 4 chests, it's the one furthest to the right.

subject: Floor 3 left-hand room
text: The remaining three chests in the Floor 3 Katana room contain a Soft potion, 4150 G, and 3400 G.

evidence.quote: Continuing on from the room where we just grabbed the Katana, there's three other chests in there (Soft potion, 4150 G, 3400 G).

subject: Floor 3 north room
text: The north room from the Floor 2 teleporter on Floating Castle Floor 3 contains 4 chests with 9000 G, Heal potion, ProRing, and 5450 G.

evidence.quote: Heading back to the teleporter from Floor 2 and going north this time, there's another room with 4 chests (9000 G, Heal potion, ProRing, 5450 G).

subject: Floor 3 east wing room
text: The east wing treasure room on Floating Castle Floor 3 contains 6 chests with 6400 G, Cloth, ProCape, Soft potion, 9500 G, and 8135 G.

evidence.quote: This floor's east wing has one more treasure room containing 6 chests (6400 G, Cloth, ProCape, Soft potion, 9500 G, 8135 G).

subject: Floor 3
text: The teleporter leading up to Floor 4 is located under the room where the Katana was found.

evidence.quote: Go up to Floor 4 via the teleporter under the room where you got the Katana.

subject: Floor 4
text: On Floating Castle Floor 4, travel east past one grid intersection, then head south at the second intersection to reach the Floor 5 teleporter.

evidence.quote: Floor 4 is massive but also empty; go east past one grid intersection, then once you reach a second intersection head south to find the Floor 5 teleporter.

subject: Warmech
text: Warmech has a 4.7% chance of spawning as a random encounter on Floor 5 of the Floating Castle.

evidence.quote: Floor 5 of the Floating Castle has a 4.7% chance of spawning a Warmech as a random encounter.

subject: Warmech
text: Warmech has 1000 max HP, 80 absorb, 100% magic evade, resists every element except Time (7% chance to hit with Stop and 0% chance with Zap!).

evidence.quote: This creature is something of a bonus boss; its 1000 max HP and 80 absorb make it bulkier than any boss you've seen thus far and it resists every element except Time (you have a 7% chance to hit it with Stop and a 0% chance to hit it with Zap!, so that defensive gap isn't doing much)...Considering its ridiculous offense and 100% magic evade, the main strategy here is to buff up a physical attacker and hope they can kill it before it kills you.

subject: Warmech
text: Warmech has accurate physical attacks and a 25% chance to cast a buffed Nuke doing over 300 non-resistable AOE damage.

evidence.quote: Warmech also has a pair of extremely accurate physical attacks that hit harder than even Chaos' and has a 25% chance to blast your party with a slightly buffed version of the Black Wizard's Nuke spell, potentially hitting for over 300 AOE non-resistable damage.

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat has 1000 HP, 100% magic evade, is weak to Poison, neutral to Status, Time and Death, resists Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Earth, and attacks hit 4 times.

evidence.quote: Tiamat statistics: 1000 HP, weak to Poison, neutral to Status, Time and Death, resists Fire, Cold, Lightning, and Earth, attacks hit 4 times...She has 100% magic evade and is neutral to Status, so most spells that inflict status ailments won't reasonably work.

subject: Tiamat
text: Tiamat has a 50% chance of attacking and a 50% chance of cycling special attacks that deal Lightning, Poison, Cold, and Fire damage in order.

evidence.quote: Tiamat has a 50% chance of attacking you and a 50% chance of cycling through a set of special attacks that do Lightning, Poison, Cold, and Fire damage, in that order.

subject: Tiamat
text: The Bane spell or Bane Sword has around a 20% chance of instantly killing Tiamat due to her Poison weakness.

evidence.quote: Tiamat is weak to Poison, which makes it *possible* for the spell to connect, but not terribly likely - the chance of any given cast connecting is around 20%...The Bane Sword's use effect is exactly as likely to hit as the black magic spell and you can use it unlimited times per fight; you also don't need to be able to equip it to cast Bane with it.

subject: Excalibur
text: Delivering the Adamant from the Floating Castle to the blacksmith in the Dwarf Cave yields the Excalibur.

evidence.quote: If you got the Adamant from the chest in the Floating Castle, deliver it to the blacksmith in the Dwarf Cave and he'll whip up the Excalibur for you.

subject: Temple of Fiends (Past)
text: Touching the black orb in the Temple of Fiends near Coneria after defeating all four fiends sends the party to Temple of Fiends (Past).

evidence.quote: After defeating all four fiends, a black orb will manifest in the Temple of Fiends near Coneria; touching it will send you back to the Temple of Fiends (Past).

subject: Floor 3
text: From the start on Floor 3 of Temple of Fiends (Past), head to the bottom right corner to find stairs leading to Floor 2.

evidence.quote: You start the Temple of Fiends (Past) on Floor 3. No chests here, aim for the bottom right corner of the floor and take the stairs to Floor 2.

subject: Floor 2
text: The interior chamber of Floor 2 has stairs leading up to Floor 1.

evidence.quote: This small interior chamber has another set of stairs leading up to Floor 1.

subject: Floor 1 central room
text: The central room on Floor 1 contains two chests holding 45000 G and 65000 G.

evidence.quote: Head to the central room of this floor to find two chests (45000 G, 65000 G), then use the Lute on the stone plate to uncover a ladder leading down.

subject: Floor 1 stone plate
text: Using the Lute on the stone plate in the Floor 1 central room uncovers a ladder leading down to the main part of Floor 2.

evidence.quote: Head to the central room of this floor to find two chests (45000 G, 65000 G), then use the Lute on the stone plate to uncover a ladder leading down. The ladder will drop you off in the main part of Floor 2; make tracks for the northwest corner of this floor to get back to Floor 3, then take the path heading west to find another set of stairs down leading to Floor 4.

subject: Lich
text: Follow the path along the outside of Floor 4 to reach the southeast corner and refight Lich to proceed to Floor 5.

evidence.quote: Nothing useful on Floor 4, follow the path along the outside of the floor to reach the southeast corner and refight Lich to proceed down to floor 5.

subject: Floor 5 south doors
text: On Floor 5, the left door leads to two chests with a ProRing and a Katana, while the right door leads to two chests with a ProCape and 26000 G.

evidence.quote: Don't approach the stairs yet, take the path south to reach a pair of doors. The left one leads to two chests (a ProRing and a Katana), the right one leads to another two chests (ProCape, 26000 G).

subject: Kary
text: Approaching the stairs down on Floor 5 triggers a refight with Kary before proceeding to Floor 6.

evidence.quote: Afterwards, retrace your steps to the stairs down, approach them to refight Kary, and make it down to floor 6.

subject: Kraken
text: The southeast corner of Floor 6 contains the Kraken refight leading to Floor 7.

evidence.quote: Floor 6 has no treasures to worry about and making your way through is just a matter of navigating the rooms with multiple doors; your goal and the Kraken refight are in the southeast corner of the floor.

subject: Masamune
text: Masamune is found on Floor 7 by heading south then east through the boxy rooms and following the corridor extending from the southeast room's southeast corner.

evidence.quote: Pick this up on Floor 7 of the Temple of Fiends (Past). From the entry stairs, head south and then east through a couple of the boxy rooms; you'll see a corridor extending from the southeast corner of the southeast room. Follow it to pick up the Masamune, then take out Tiamat again and move down to Floor 8.

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos has 2000 HP, 100% magic resistance, resists all elements, attacks twice per turn, and can inflict non-elemental paralysis.

evidence.quote: Chaos Statistics: 2000 HP, Resistant to All Elements, Attack hits twice, Attack can inflict paralysis (non-elemental)...Chaos has a 100% magic resistance on top of his full suite of elemental resists, so offensive magic is suboptimal here.

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos has a 25% chance of physical attacks, 25% chance of special attacks (Crack, Inferno, Swirl, Tornado), and 50% chance of cycling spells (Ice3 -> Lit3 -> Slo2 -> Cur4 -> Fir3 -> Ice2 -> Fast -> Nuke).

evidence.quote: Chaos has a 25% chance of attacking you physically, a 25% chance to use a special attack from a list of Crack (Earth-elemental instant KO), Inferno (heavy fire magic damage to all allies), Swirl, and Tornado (identical non-elemental full party magic attacks, not as much raw power as Inferno but can't be resisted), and a 50% chance of cycling through a spell list of Ice3 -> Lit3 -> Slo2 -> Cur4 -> Fir3 -> Ice2 -> Fast -> Nuke.

subject: Chaos
text: Chaos is fully repeatable, allowing players who beat him without optional items to return and defeat him without healing on a second run.

evidence.quote: It should be noted that Chaos is technically a fully repeatable fight, and a run that beat him without picking up any optional items will have a considerable victory lap to mastery anyway since they will have to go clear out every dungeon (including the Temple of Fiends). If you find that you need healing to win in the no-optional-chests fight, you can go back and do this after your collecting spree, putting a pretty fitting cap on your mastery.
